name: citrus_engine_pick_broadcast_ms
description: DISTRIBUTION of `pick.processed.broadcastMs` (server/src/draft/LobbyManager.ts): the uWS publish cost after the RPC commits — the server-side half of the Mandate's pick-to-broadcast fanout target (p95 <= 200 ms). Duplicate submits (wasDuplicate=true) skip the broadcast and are excluded here so their broadcastMs=0 does not flatter the distribution. Value is regex-extracted from the raw JSON line because the gcplogs driver does not parse it (see README). Managed by infra/gcp/monitoring/apply-monitoring.sh.
filter: (jsonPayload.container.metadata.app="citrus-draft-engine" OR labels.app="citrus-draft-engine") AND (jsonPayload.event="pick.processed" OR jsonPayload.message:"\"event\":\"pick.processed\"") AND NOT (jsonPayload.wasDuplicate=true OR jsonPayload.message:"\"wasDuplicate\":true")

labels.description: true = engine-fired autopick; false = manual pick through the engine path.
Docker label `environment` forwarded by the gcplogs driver (production / staging).
